column2: [intro]
I started a novel, sublime and grand,
But after a few chapters, I’m losing the stand.
The characters plead, "Please finish our tale!"
But I’m already soaring to new heights without fail.
I never finish books, such audacity!
Barely halfway, I lose track so easily.
The pages slip through my fingers, oh my,
An unfinished adventure is my sigh.
I dive into a thriller, full of suspense and twists,
But the end remains a mystery, I flee without a mist.
The suspects whirl, dancing before my eyes,
But I'd rather move on, I don’t know them, no lies.
I never finish books, such audacity!
Barely halfway, I lose track so easily.
The pages slip through my fingers, oh my,
An unfinished adventure is my sigh.
